fleet_model.initial_staging: same deterministic positions produced by the Phase 10 shared fleet constructor
fleet_model.hardware_and_runtime_safety: same scenario equipment, shared station capacity, per-UAV access/backhaul capacities, speed, city boundary, battery reserve, sortie-return guard and minimum fleet separation as Phase 10
fleet_model.wireless_interference: not modeled; no co-channel interference claim
fleet_model.event_visibility: current observable network/user/battery state and events at or before the current tick only

algorithm_definitions.H_marginal_rescue_greedy: Select UAVs in deterministic ID order. For each, evaluate every route/energy-feasible candidate against already selected locations using the shared allocator; choose the candidate with greatest unique rescue-service marginal gain, then total-service marginal gain, and only then energy, movement, latency and stable-coordinate tie breaks. Recheck shared capacities after each selection.
algorithm_definitions.I_constrained_user_assignment: Keep all UAVs at their current/staged positions. Build feasible whole-user direct or UAV relay alternatives; run bounded deterministic beam search for rescue-first generalized capacitated assignment. Each user is assigned to at most one path and consumes the shared station capacity plus, for relay paths, one UAV access and its backhaul budget. Reassign each sampling tick. This does not plan UAV positions or claim a global optimum.
algorithm_definitions.J_budgeted_joint_beam: Reuse G's exact per-UAV ranked candidate shortlists and lexicographic objective, but search partial joint assignments with deterministic beam width 16. Apply the same 2,000 ms wall-clock deadline and 512 feasible joint-evaluation cap; report partial safe plans on budget exhaustion. G's full shortlisted Cartesian enumeration remains unchanged.

analysis.seed_pairing: All eleven policy configurations for a scenario/seed use one shared DynamicWorldTrace and identical scenario config.
analysis.censoring: Unrecovered first-full recovery time uses the scenario duration as a right-censor endpoint; success n/total remains primary for recovery probability.
analysis.latency: Conditional on each policy's own successful user-time samples; report sample counts and do not treat differing user sets as paired latency evidence.
analysis.confirmatory_tests: Paired seed differences for all predeclared same-size F/G/H/I/J and single-Bprime contrasts, two-sided exact sign-flip for rescue-service rates and McNemar for binary recovery; Holm correction by endpoint family across all scenario contrasts.
analysis.summary: Per scenario and fleet size report mean, sample SD, 95% t interval, paired difference, 95% CI and standardized paired effect. Show four scenario strata before any overall summary.
